dashboard.name: Click Actions
dashboard.description: Three click-action types demonstrated end-to-end on the e-commerce dataset.

chartOptions.content:
## Click action: `set-parameter`

Clicking a bar below sets the `$category` parameter. The table on the right re-runs its query against the new value. Use the dropdown to pick a starting value before you click.

**Try it:** click **Electronics** in the bar chart — the table refreshes to show only electronics products.

chartOptions.seedQuery: SELECT name AS value, name AS label FROM neoboard_demo_public.categories WHERE parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY name

widgets.query: SELECT parent.name AS category, SUM(oi.qty * oi.price)::float AS revenue FROM neoboard_demo_public.order_items oi JOIN neoboard_demo_public.products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN neoboard_demo_public.categories sub ON sub.id = p.category_id JOIN neoboard_demo_public.categories parent ON parent.id = sub.parent_id GROUP BY parent.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

settings.title: Revenue by top-level category — click a bar

widgets.query: SELECT p.name AS product, p.price, p.cost, (p.price - p.cost)::float AS margin FROM neoboard_demo_public.products p JOIN neoboard_demo_public.categories sub ON sub.id = p.category_id JOIN neoboard_demo_public.categories parent ON parent.id = sub.parent_id WHERE parent.name = $param_category ORDER BY p.price DESC

chartOptions.content:
## Click action: `navigate-to-page`

Clicking a slice on the pie chart navigates to the **Order Status Detail** page in this same dashboard. Pure routing — no data is carried over, so the destination page does its own query.

**Try it:** click any slice.

widgets.query: SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM neoboard_demo_public.orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC

settings.title: Orders by status — click a slice to open detail page

chartOptions.content:
## Order Status Detail

You arrived here via the pie-chart click on the previous page. This destination runs its own query — `navigate-to-page` does not carry parameter values from the source.

The table below shows a sample of recent orders across all statuses.

widgets.query: SELECT o.id, o.status, o.total::float AS total, to_char(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS order_date, c.name AS customer FROM neoboard_demo_public.orders o JOIN neoboard_demo_public.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

chartOptions.content:
## Click action: `set-parameter-and-navigate`

Clicking a region bar **both** sets the `$region` parameter **and** navigates to the **Region Drilldown** page in one step. The destination picks up the new parameter value and shows filtered data.

**Try it:** click any region bar.

widgets.query: SELECT r.name AS region, SUM(o.total)::float AS revenue FROM neoboard_demo_public.orders o JOIN neoboard_demo_public.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN neoboard_demo_public.regions r ON r.id = c.region_id GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

settings.title: Revenue by region — click to filter + jump

chartOptions.content:
## Region Drilldown — $param_region

You arrived here via a `set-parameter-and-navigate` click. The `$region` parameter was set from the clicked bar's label, and this page's widgets now filter on it.

chartOptions.seedQuery: SELECT name AS value, name AS label FROM neoboard_demo_public.regions ORDER BY name

widgets.query: SELECT SUM(o.total)::float AS revenue FROM neoboard_demo_public.orders o JOIN neoboard_demo_public.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN neoboard_demo_public.regions r ON r.id = c.region_id WHERE r.name = $param_region

SELECT c.name AS customer, c.city, c.email, SUM(o.total)::float AS total_spend FROM neoboard_demo_public.customers c JOIN neoboard_demo_public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN neoboard_demo_public.regions r ON r.id = c.region_id WHERE r.name = $param_region GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.city, c.email ORDER BY total_spend DESC
